verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, and running AI coding agents from a mobile terminal is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions an AI agent, pull-request analysis, or code-improvement suggestions. Bundled Python with pip, Vim with vim-lsp/ALE syntax checkers, and Shortcuts integration are only developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent analyze my pull requests and suggest code improvements from my phone
